query:
INSERT INTO job_events (
            job_id,
            run_number,
            attempt,
            event_type,
            payload
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            $3,
            'CANCELED',
            jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
                'reason', $4::text,
                'lease_quiesces_at', $5::timestamptz
            ))
         )
